title: The Fabled Kerafyrm the Awakened
summary: The fabled awakened dragon alternates a leading-target attack with a slower area attack.
overview: The fabled awakened dragon alternates a leading-target attack with a slower area attack.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep tank healing and raid recovery ready for overlapping spell timers.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Single-target casting begins 12 to 18 seconds after spawn and then repeats every 35 seconds.
The area spell begins 20 to 28 seconds after spawn and then repeats every 60 seconds.
Death signals the Sleep Walking controller to record the finale lockout.

notes: Approval E293. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Timers start on spawn, not engagement. Live spell data must be checked before assigning effect names or avoidance advice.
